links.outcome: Internal consistency (text wording similarity) of ChatGPT answers when each question was posed 3 times
links.effect: Mean text similarity across repeated trials was 49% (SD 15), rated unacceptable across all 3 trials in all 9 clinical questions.
links.quote: The internal consistency of text ChatGPT answers was unacceptable across all 3 trials in all clinical questions (mean percentage of 49%, standard deviation of 15).

links.outcome: Agreement of ChatGPT answers with clinical practice guideline recommendations for lumbosacral radicular pain
links.effect: Accuracy versus CPG recommendations was slight, with agreement in 33% of recommendations.
links.quote: Accuracy between ChatGPT answers and CPGs recommendations was slight, demonstrating agreement in 33% of recommendations.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating the accuracy and consistency of ChatGPT (GPT-3.5) against clinical practice guidelines for lumbosacral radicular pain without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
